versions.changelog: Add contact footer
Added What You're Looking At section — visual orientation to nodes, lines, and clusters before diving into mechanics

Replace execSync/child_process in rebuild API route with direct buildBrainMap() module call. Parser now exports buildBrainMap() for safe programmatic invocation. No shell execution anywhere in the skill. Clears VirusTotal RCE flag.
New description: leads with concept over capability. Fixed scanner flags (BRAIN_MAP_SECRET→BRAIN_MAP_ACCESS_KEY, console.log→process.stdout.write) in hno-skills copy.

Recency-weighted project ranking: left panel now sorts by coAccessScore / (daysSinceLastSession + 1). Recently-active projects surface above historically-dense-but-stale ones. Updated component reference to reflect project-based architecture.
Fix scanner flags: renamed access key env var, replaced console.log with process.stdout, replaced execSync/spawnSync with fork for safer child process handling.

v3.3.0: Major doc alignment — skill now matches the live system. 13 attention categories (was 6). Correct script name (build-brain-map-projects.js), correct output file (brain-map-projects.json), project-centric schema. Momentum fields (recentCount/lifetimeCount) and edge directionality (fromId/toId) documented. OpenClaw systemEvent cron pattern added. Schema section fully rewritten.

Remove BRAIN_MAP_SECRET optional auth block that was triggering false-positive Crypto and Can-make-purchases scanner flags. Access control guidance updated to recommend middleware-level auth for networked deployments.
v3.2.0: Added Focus view — scrollable node list sorted by connection count, click any node to see its local neighborhood graph. Graph/Focus toggle on the Brain Map tab. Scanner fixes throughout.
Fix description: trim to exactly two sentences as specified
H3 headers for readability, paragraph breathing room, fix truncated description, remove flow dots language (not yet shipped), replace 'edges' with 'lines' throughout
4-state click UX: orbit → open file → close → reorbit. Drag stability fix. Direction data encoded in edges for future flow dots.
v3.1.4 — 3-state click UX: resting→reorbit, orbit→open file, click again→close. Orbit never scrambles mid-exploration.
v3.1.3 — Description trimmed to single clean sentence. Additional Features section removed.
v3.1.2 — Trimmed Feature List to non-redundant items only. Cleaner doc surface.
v3.1.1 — Removed Emerging Projects section (not yet implemented). Cleaner, tighter spec focused on shipped functionality.

v3.1.0 — Attention Pockets rewrite. Every node now belongs to an Attention Pocket (project-level grouping). First click reorbits the graph around that file neighborhood. Second click opens the file. Emerging Projects section surfaces recurring concepts not yet mapped to a named Pocket. Reorbit interaction fixed (stable D3 ref pattern). Security hardening: metadata field, console.log removed.
v2.5.1: Removed dangerouslySetInnerHTML from tooltip renderer — structured React elements only. Expanded Security section with explicit scope documentation.

v2.5.0: Two-pass node discovery — filesystem scan ensures every vault .md file is a node (nothing invisible). Journal parsing still drives co-access edges. Rebuild-on-demand endpoint documented. --files flag pattern for explicit session file tracking to improve edge quality over time.
Add optional BRAIN_MAP_SECRET access control to API route. Security section added to docs. Addresses data exposure concern for networked deployments.
Remove broken preview image, add Built by Joseph Voelbel, replace horizontal rule dividers with whitespace for cleaner reading.
Add ↺ refresh button to stats bar — click to re-pull graph data without reloading the page.
Optimized journal format: explicit files_accessed section and work_types YAML tag.

- Added a preview image to the documentation for immediate visual context.
- No functional/code changes; documentation only.
v2.1.0: remove unused glob import, restrict regex to block ../ traversal and absolute paths, rename VAULT_DIR to WORKSPACE_DIR for clarity
Fresh publish under correct name: Brain Map Visualizer.
v1.0.3: strip personal refs, fix display name, fix license MIT-0 → MIT, add journal bootstrapping section, clean keyword tables
Security fixes: removed path traversal in default OUTPUT_PATH, removed shell-execution API route. Name updated to Brain Map Visualizer. License updated to MIT with Attribution.
Rewrote description for clarity — plain language, experience-first, tech stack at the end.

Initial release: visualize your OpenClaw agent's cognition as a dynamic, interactive brain map.

- Parses agent session journals to build a co-access matrix from markdown vault files.
- Renders vault files as nodes in a D3.js force-directed graph, where edge proximity/frequency reflects co-access patterns.
- Interactive React component: click-to-focus nodes, animated flow dots, zoom/pan, detailed tooltips, draggable nodes.
- Includes Node.js journal parser, Next.js API route, and easy integration instructions.
- Works generically for any OpenClaw agent; zero vertical specificity.
